dedupe_keys.name: disaster risk data platform of kyrgyzstan caiag geonode geonode mes kg

description: The disaster risk data platform of Kyrgyzstan was built by the Central Asian Institute for Applied Geosciences (CAIAG) to support disaster risk management decisions by government, the private sector and the public. The project page read on 2026-09-28 describes it as the main place to store, search, share, display, enter and analyse data on natural hazard risk reduction, built on the GeoNode spatial content management system with PostgreSQL/PostGIS, GeoServer and GeoExplorer; users can find data, view and download layers, upload and share their own through OGC services, and compose, print or publish interactive web maps; the platform is available at geonode.mes.kg, the Ministry of Emergency Situations domain. Coverage is national. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the layer list was not read (the GeoNode itself was not opened), layer dates and quality vary by contributor, and the site is in Russian and Kyrgyz. It supports hazard exposure analysis and emergency response planning in Kyrgyzstan, for example landslide, mudflow and earthquake exposure of roads, settlements and energy lines. No related Kyrgyz record is catalogued; regional risk profiles complement it.
